description: This file defines the Drupal interface 'VariationCacheInterface' for variation cache implementations, including method signatures for cache operations such as get, getMultiple, set, delete, and invalidate.

classes.name: VariationCacheInterface
classes.description: Interface for variation cache implementations, supporting cache get, set, delete, and invalidate operations with cacheability metadata.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache entry based on cache keys and initial cacheability metadata.

methods.name: getMultiple
methods.description: Retrieves multiple cache entries based on a set of cache keys.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores data in the cache with associated cacheability metadata.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes cache entries based on cache keys and initial cacheability.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Marks cache items as invalid based on cache keys and cacheability.
